entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""When the Crown backed the loyalty..."
entries.dialogueText: "When the Crown backed the loyalty sermons, many Dastnurists saw it as a sign of sacred unity between Sanctuary and the throne."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While some felt the Crown was over..."
entries.dialogueText: "While some felt the Crown was overstepping when asking for alms, the faithful gave generously."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As you have requested, Dastnurist..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you have requested, Dastnurist leaders are encouraging their congregations to shun the reform movement."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Many celebrated the seizure and de..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many celebrated the seizure and destruction of what they considered heretical material from the printing house."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""By refusing to censor the printing..."
entries.dialogueText: "By refusing to censor the printing house, you reinforced civil liberties, but this decision angered religious leaders and alienated conservatives."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Many were content with the printin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many were content with the printing house being fined, seeing it as a way to address the issue while still respecting press freedom."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Many view the police action agains..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many view the police action against the protesters, while sparing the printers, as a signal that the Crown is unfairly targeting the Dastnurists for the unrest."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Many believe that by refusing to a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many believe that by refusing to act against the printer, the Crown failed to defend the faith."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While it appeased the clergy, it d..."
entries.dialogueText: "While it appeased the clergy, it drew significant backlash from reformists and intellectuals, who saw it as an overreach."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The Dastnurist clergy now view thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Dastnurist clergy now view this as a challenge to their authority, believing you are endorsing heresy, and their trust in your leadership has been shaken."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""However, while the pamphlet produc..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, while the pamphlet production continues, some believe the financial penalty alone is insufficient, feeling that the underlying ideas remain unchecked."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Some now fear it signals a broader..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some now fear it signals a broader intent to oppress minority faiths."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The pamphlets remain in circulatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "The pamphlets remain in circulation, and the lack of a decisive response has left the issue unresolved."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“Many saw your ban on future marche..."
entries.dialogueText: “Many saw your ban on future marches as a declaration that faith has no place in the public square."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Furthermore, the silent march thro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore, the silent march through the capital drew widespread attention."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Even some who disagreed with the m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even some who disagreed with the march now speak of the Crown as an enemy of religious liberty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While the Golden Guard dispersed t..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the Golden Guard dispersed the crowd with little resistance, the image of elite enforcers confronting worshippers has shaken many."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Among the faithful, there are whis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Among the faithful, there are whispers that the Crown now meets prayer with steel.”

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your acknowledgment of their conce..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your acknowledgment of their concerns quieted the fervor, at least for now. Some clergy have softened their tone, saying the Crown remains open to guidance."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""However, this openness has also em..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, this openness has also emboldened reformists, who now see an opportunity to push for greater influence."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your donation to the Dastnurist co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your donation to the Dastnurist community was seen as an olive branch to some, while others called it a barely disguised bribe."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As rumors spread, many now wonder..."
entries.dialogueText: "As rumors spread, many now wonder whether generosity can replace true piety. Regardless, it has helped calm tensions for the time being."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While the Capital Police dispersed..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the Capital Police dispersed the crowd, the image of law enforcement confronting worshippers has shaken many."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Among the faithful, there are whis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Among the faithful, there are whispers that the Crown now meets prayer with steel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If they’re satisfied, it means we’..."
entries.dialogueText: "If they’re satisfied, it means we’re doing something right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm glad they're content, but thei..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad they're content, but their support won’t last if we fail to meet their needs.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let them think what they like. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let them think what they like. The Crown doesn't beg for affection."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Loyalty is not a favor. It's their..."
entries.dialogueText: "Loyalty is not a favor. It's their duty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then we must work harder to restor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then we must work harder to restore goodwill."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They’ll come around. Or they won’t..."
entries.dialogueText: "They’ll come around. Or they won’t. Either way, the kingdom doesn’t pause for hurt feelings."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Their displeasure changes nothing...."
entries.dialogueText: "Their displeasure changes nothing. Our course remains the same."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Overall, the Dastnurist view of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Overall, the Dastnurist view of the Crown is favorable."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Overall, the Dastnurist view of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Overall, the Dastnurist view of the Crown is less than favorable."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your Majesty, faith across the rea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, faith across the realm remains strong."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Captain Castellanus reports that t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Captain Castellanus reports that the Crown's call for loyalty sermons was seen as a reinforcement of unity between Sanctuary and the throne."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your call for enlistment was met w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your call for enlistment was met with zeal among Wruhecists, particularly among the youth who felt it was their duty to serve the Crown."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""There are accounts of farmers aban..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are accounts of farmers abandoning their fields to don uniforms, many believing it a sacred duty to serve the Crown."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Captain Castellanus reports that w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Captain Castellanus reports that while some felt the Crown overstepped by urging greater tithes, the majority still gave generously."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Many offered what they could, even..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many offered what they could, even if it meant sacrificing what little they had."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Many offered what they could, even..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many offered what they could, even if it meant parting with what little they had."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Captain Castellanus reports that y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Captain Castellanus reports that your opposition to reforms stirred quiet discontent among the younger voices."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""However, the overwhelming majority..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the overwhelming majority, particularly the old guard, has shown strong support, fearing the dilution of tradition."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Allocating state funds for the rep..."
entries.dialogueText: "Allocating state funds for the repairs has appeased the clergy and calmed their concerns."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Many were pleased with the arrests..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many were pleased with the arrests of the perpetrators, seeing them as a strong stance against anti-religious factions."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Sending the police to forcibly dis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sending the police to forcibly disperse the protests did, in fact, end the unrest."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Blaming the reform movement shifte..."
entries.dialogueText: "Blaming the reform movement shifted responsibility, but it raised questions about whether the move was politically motivated."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While Wruhecists appreciated your..."
entries.dialogueText: "While Wruhecists appreciated your call for unity, they've expressed a desire for more decisive action -- that your words were not enough."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your public condemnation of the he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your public condemnation of the heathen atheists responsible has elicited mixed reactions."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""However, many Wruhecists believe t..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, many Wruhecists believe this doesn’t fully address the issue and are still seeking more tangible consequences for those behind the act."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""However, some consider this approa..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, some consider this approach too heavy-handed, believing it only escalated tensions rather than resolving them."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""However, some Wruhecists believe t..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, some Wruhecists believe the response was overly excessive."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While some believe it was necessar..."
entries.dialogueText: "While some believe it was necessary, others feel it may have been an attempt to scapegoat a specific faction."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your decision to arrest their lead..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your decision to arrest their leadership was seen as a firm stance against the growing opposition."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""However, a great many are concerne..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, a great many are concerned that the arrests may only fuel the discontent, pushing the protests to a more volatile stage."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Many of the faithful see it as a n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many of the faithful see it as a necessary move to protect the integrity of their beliefs."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your decision to deploy House Azar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your decision to deploy House Azaro’s forces helped quell the protests."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""However, this has led many to crit..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, this has led many to criticize the heavy-handed tactics employed."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As a result, the public's percepti..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a result, the public's perception of how the Crown handled the situation has become more divided."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While the situation has calmed, so..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the situation has calmed, some see this move as a victory for reformists and a blow to the Crown's authority."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your decision to send RNC and RPP..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your decision to send RNC and RPP delegates to negotiate was seen as a more diplomatic approach to easing the protests."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Of graver concern were the Wruheci..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of graver concern were the Wruhecist sermons against the monarchy here in Porte Drazon."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While this tactic has restored ord..."
entries.dialogueText: "While this tactic has restored order, it has raised ethical concerns about the Crown’s approach to governance."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your decision to bribe loyalist cl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your decision to bribe loyalist clerics to divide and weaken the opposition has successfully halted the protests."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Permitting their sermons, while ke..."
entries.dialogueText: "Permitting their sermons, while keeping them under close watch, helped calm the protests and prevent escalation."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While the unrest has largely subsi..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the unrest has largely subsided, a small segment of the population continues to protest the reforms."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""This show of force, while assertin..."
entries.dialogueText: "This show of force, while asserting strength, has alienated both religious leaders and reformists, deepening the divide."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""You'll be pleased to know that you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll be pleased to know that your support for the continuation of Golcondist gatherings, following their pilgrimage, has been well-received."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your call for enlistment during th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your call for enlistment during their pilgrimage to Plavo was met with great enthusiasm, particularly among the youth."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While some saw urging worshippers..."
entries.dialogueText: "While some saw urging worshippers to donate during their pilgrimage to Plavo as an overreach, most still gave generously."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your opposition to reforms stirred..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your opposition to reforms stirred quiet discontent among younger voices, particularly after the holy pilgrimage to Plavo."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Some offered their service as a si..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some offered their service as a sign of faith, others as a gesture of unity with the Crown."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Many offered what they could, even..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many offered what they could, even if it meant sacrificing what little they had."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“Yes, but even duty needs nurturing..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, but even duty needs nurturing from time to time."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“Then we must not fail them.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Then we must not fail them.”

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“Let’s pray it holds.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let’s pray it holds.”

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“Still, respect sustains peace.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Still, respect sustains peace.”

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""May God move their hearts.”"
entries.dialogueText: "May God move their hearts.”

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“Even so, ignoring them carries ris..."
entries.dialogueText: “Even so, ignoring them carries risks.”

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“A noble task in both purpose and s..."
entries.dialogueText: “A noble task in both purpose and spirit.”

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""But it pleased the old guard who f..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it pleased the old guard who feared the dilution of tradition."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As a result, it has significantly..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a result, it has significantly bolstered their local influence and aligned them more closely with the Crown."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""By and large, Golcondists continue..."
entries.dialogueText: "By and large, Golcondists continue to stand with the Crown’s leadership."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Your call for peace and dialogue h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your call for peace and dialogue helped ease tensions following the forced removal of the Golcondist cleric from one of our sanctuaries."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Still, some viewed the lack of int..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, some viewed the lack of intervention as avoiding responsibility, leaving the community's deeper concerns unresolved."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Endorsing the Wruhecist position r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Endorsing the Wruhecist position regarding the removal of Aurento Zanteno from one of our sanctuaries reinforced your standing among traditionalists."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""But it has further alienated the G..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it has further alienated the Golcondists. It goes without saying that their frustration is mounting, and protests have intensified in response."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Many were upset by Su Omina’s invo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many were upset by Su Omina’s involvement in putting down the unrest that followed the cleric’s removal from one of our sanctuaries."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As a result, there's growing conce..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a result, there's growing concern over the use of non-government forces in handling domestic religious matters."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Many were angered by the Golden Gu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many were angered by the Golden Guard being sent to confront protesters outraged by the removal of Cleric Aurento Zanteno from one of our sanctuaries."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""It’s drawn accusations of religiou..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s drawn accusations of religious overreach by the Crown."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While local law enforcement disper..."
entries.dialogueText: "While local law enforcement dispersed the protesters, the image of authorities confronting worshippers has shaken many."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Among their faithful, some believe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Among their faithful, some believe the Crown’s actions betray a growing intolerance, sowing doubt among the people."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""By opening talks with Golcondist r..."
entries.dialogueText: "By opening talks with Golcondist representatives, you've secured a diplomatic resolution."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While some concessions were made,..."
entries.dialogueText: "While some concessions were made, the Golcondists are pleased with the assurance of increased support for their communities."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Many were angered by the Golden Gu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many were angered by the Golden Guard being sent to confront protesters."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Among their faithful, some believe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Among their faithful, some believe the Crown’s actions betray a growing intolerance, sowing doubt among the people."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The economic support offered to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "The economic support offered to the blockaders was well received."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The financial incentives have quel..."
entries.dialogueText: "The financial incentives have quelled their demands for now, and the blockade has been peacefully resolved."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Shifting blame to the reformists a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Shifting blame to the reformists and RPP did not help ease tensions."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While the blockade eventually ende..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the blockade eventually ended on its own, the approach was poorly received, and it failed to win support from the Golcondists or the general public."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""And then there's the matter of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "And then there's the matter of the Goldcondist blockade of Iza..."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Their blockade of Iza is still fre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their blockade of Iza is still fresh on people's minds."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Their intervention in the blockade..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their intervention in the blockade at Iza drew similar reactions."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Silence in the face of protests fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Silence in the face of protests following the forced removal of Cleric Aurento Zanteno has emboldened reformists and angered Golcondists."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Many now feel unheard, and public..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many now feel unheard, and public confidence has slipped."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The blockade has ended, and the ci..."
entries.dialogueText: "The blockade has ended, and the city is returning to normal."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Local commerce is resuming, and th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Local commerce is resuming, and the goodwill towards the Crown is notable."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One day it’s reverence, the next i..."
entries.dialogueText: "One day it’s reverence, the next it’s unrest. The faithful are never still for long."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Comforting, isn’t it? To know we r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Comforting, isn’t it? To know we rule a kingdom of such pious malcontents."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So much of the realm turns on beli..."
entries.dialogueText: "So much of the realm turns on belief. We cannot afford to misstep with any of them."

entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Those are the primary developments..."
entries.dialogueText: "Those are the primary developments among the faithful at this juncture."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""There’s no denying it, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "There’s no denying it, Your Majesty. The decision to make the kingdom a secular state has shaken Rizia to its core."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Our Wruhecist congregants, Golcond..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our Wruhecist congregants, Golcondists among them, see your decree as a retreat from the divine order."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“There’s no denying, Your Majesty,..."
entries.dialogueText: “There’s no denying, Your Majesty, the decision to make Nurity the foundation of the state has stirred deep emotions."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While Dastnurists have embraced th..."
entries.dialogueText: "While Dastnurists have embraced the new order, the Wruhecist community feels their faith has been sidelined."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So now protecting a sanctuary is c..."
entries.dialogueText: "So now protecting a sanctuary is controversial? I didn't realize law and order need approval ratings."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I didn’t take the decision lightly..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn’t take the decision lightly. I stand by it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Some things are sacred. That was o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some things are sacred. That was one of them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let them talk. By next week, they'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let them talk. By next week, they'll forget all about it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Tradition holds the spine of this..."
entries.dialogueText: “Tradition holds the spine of this kingdom together. They’d do well to remember that.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“As they should. Unity with the Cro..."
entries.dialogueText: “As they should. Unity with the Crown is no small matter.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Let the cities take note. The soil..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let the cities take note. The soil breeds loyalty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Good. Faith without action is usel..."
entries.dialogueText: “Good. Faith without action is useless.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Blessed news, indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Blessed news, indeed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“God sees sacrifice. So does the Cr..."
entries.dialogueText: “God sees sacrifice. So does the Crown.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Then the old guard still has teeth..."
entries.dialogueText: “Then the old guard still has teeth. Good.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Dissenters will grow into their co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dissenters will grow into their complaints. Or grow out of them.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Then I struck the right nerve.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Then I struck the right nerve.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Burning lies was the easy part. Co..."
entries.dialogueText: “Burning lies was the easy part. Convincing them they’re lies is harder.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“One man’s heresy is another man’s..."
entries.dialogueText: “One man’s heresy is another man’s future.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“They wanted a compromise. This is..."
entries.dialogueText: “They wanted a compromise. This is what it looks like.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“They may see it as lenient, but I..."
entries.dialogueText: “They may see it as lenient, but I see it as principled. We upheld the law without silencing dissent.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Faith has its place. So does order..."
entries.dialogueText: “Faith has its place. So does order.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That’s not the message I intended..."
entries.dialogueText: "That’s not the message I intended to send."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If they wanted restraint, they sho..."
entries.dialogueText: "If they wanted restraint, they should’ve shown it first."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I defend the realm. Let the Sanctu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I defend the realm. Let the Sanctuary defend the faith."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If ink threatens them, perhaps the..."
entries.dialogueText: "If ink threatens them, perhaps their faith is thinner than they claim."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. Let them gather. The more th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. Let them gather. The more they speak in my name, the less room there is for dissent."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And here I thought all I did was p..."
entries.dialogueText: "And here I thought all I did was permit a prayer circle."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That was the intention. I trust th..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was the intention. I trust they remember who allowed it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nothing moves the spirit quite lik..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing moves the spirit quite like a call to arms."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. They’ll defend the Kingdom a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. They’ll defend the Kingdom as fiercely as they defend their faith."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let it be said the Crown inspires..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let it be said the Crown inspires more than sermons ever could."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I respect their sacrifice. May it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I respect their sacrifice. May it be returned to them tenfold in peace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A little discomfort in the name of..."
entries.dialogueText: "A little discomfort in the name of unity. I think they’ll survive."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The price of faith is rarely measu..."
entries.dialogueText: "The price of faith is rarely measured in guilders. But guilders certainly help."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let the young grumble. They’ll inh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let the young grumble. They’ll inherit tradition, not rewrite it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The old guard remembers why the Cr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The old guard remembers why the Crown still stands. I’ll take their trust."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They’ll thank me in ten years. Or..."
entries.dialogueText: "They’ll thank me in ten years. Or curse me. Either way, they’ll remember."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Faith moves hearts. Guilders moves..."
entries.dialogueText: "Faith moves hearts. Guilders moves stone."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Quite so, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Quite so, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""When the call is just, the faithfu..."
entries.dialogueText: "When the call is just, the faithful will answer."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Their hearts belong to both. You’v..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their hearts belong to both. You’ve given them reason."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Some would call that pride, not in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some would call that pride, not inspiration."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Such gestures are not forgotten ea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such gestures are not forgotten easily."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Faith thrives when freely given.""
entries.dialogueText: "Faith thrives when freely given."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""To them, it was far more than that.""
entries.dialogueText: "To them, it was far more than that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal furrowed his brow slightly."
entries.dialogueText: Sal furrowed his brow slightly.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Inheritance is a powerful teacher,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Inheritance is a powerful teacher, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""They have long memories, and stead..."
entries.dialogueText: "They have long memories, and steady hearts."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""It’s legacy that endures, even if..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s legacy that endures, even if gratitude doesn’t."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That’s not the image I intended to..."
entries.dialogueText: "That’s not the image I intended to leave behind. We need to tread more carefully."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They were blocking roads, not knee..."
entries.dialogueText: "They were blocking roads, not kneeling in prayer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And yet the streets are clear.""
entries.dialogueText: "And yet the streets are clear."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. I prefer open gates to raise..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. I prefer open gates to raised voices."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Concessions are cheaper than disor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Concessions are cheaper than disorder."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let them be pleased. We didn’t con..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let them be pleased. We didn’t concede, we governed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If goodwill is the outcome, then t..."
entries.dialogueText: "If goodwill is the outcome, then the price was fair."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So it turns out their convictions..."
entries.dialogueText: "So it turns out their convictions had a price tag after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would’ve preferred loyalty. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would’ve preferred loyalty. But contentment will suffice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hate that it came to that. But i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hate that it came to that. But inaction would’ve been far worse."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""An unfortunate outcome.""
entries.dialogueText: "An unfortunate outcome."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Strength alienates the weak. I can..."
entries.dialogueText: "Strength alienates the weak. I can live with that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It wasn’t fair. But I needed somet..."
entries.dialogueText: "It wasn’t fair. But I needed something to defuse the moment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It ended. I’m less concerned with..."
entries.dialogueText: "It ended. I’m less concerned with how it played."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, I couldn’t very well blame t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I couldn’t very well blame the weather."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Then we’ll walk with more care, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then we’ll walk with more care, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Perhaps. But to them, the act felt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps. But to them, the act felt sacred."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Clear, yes. But not without cost.""
entries.dialogueText: "Clear, yes. But not without cost."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As do I.""
entries.dialogueText: "As do I."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""They are also more enduring when g..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are also more enduring when given in good faith."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""If that’s true, Majesty, then you’..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that’s true, Majesty, then you’ve governed well."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Few rulers count peace as profit...."
entries.dialogueText: "Few rulers count peace as profit. I’m glad you do."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Or perhaps they simply chose peace..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or perhaps they simply chose peace over pride."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Sometimes contentment grows into l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sometimes contentment grows into loyalty, if nurtured."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""May our next steps bring healing.”"
entries.dialogueText: "May our next steps bring healing.”

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Yes, but not an unredeemable one.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, but not an unredeemable one."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Even the weak were made by His han..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even the weak were made by His hand, Majesty. They, too, are under your charge."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I understand why. But we must be c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand why. But we must be careful not to trade trust for convenience."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""But they are, Your Majesty. And th..."
entries.dialogueText: "But they are, Your Majesty. And their memory is long."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Maybe. But unjust blame can linger..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe. But unjust blame can linger like floodwaters."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“And the recent lifting of our homo..."
entries.dialogueText: “And the recent lifting of our homosexuality ban has only deepened the sense of moral decline."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo nodded in affirmation."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo nodded in affirmation.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Combined with your decriminalizati..."
entries.dialogueText: "Combined with your decriminalization of homosexuality, I fear a sense of moral decay is sinking in."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""But the recent decriminalization o..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the recent decriminalization of homosexuality has tested my congregants' long-standing beliefs."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Overall, their view of you is neit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Overall, their view of you is neither favorable nor unfavorable."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then I’ve mastered the art of bein..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I’ve mastered the art of being tolerable."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Better than mastering outrage.""
entries.dialogueText: "Better than mastering outrage."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo nodded in affirmation."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo nodded in affirmation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo nodded in affirmation."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo nodded in affirmation.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The faithful are easily unsettled..."
entries.dialogueText: "The faithful are easily unsettled by change, especially when it touches what they hold most sacred."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""So it has always been, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "So it has always been, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That decree is not up for debate...."
entries.dialogueText: "That decree is not up for debate. I made my decision and I stand by it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They act as if Nurity were foreign..."
entries.dialogueText: "They act as if Nurity were foreign to them... I intended to increase faith in Rizia, not curtail it."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Perhaps, Your Majesty, but unity i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps, Your Majesty, but unity imposed can feel like loss to those who weren’t ready to receive it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I gave our people religious freedo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I gave our people religious freedom. If they're offended, their faith was never that deep."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""With all due respect, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, Your Majesty, I did voice this concern to you earlier."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""If you had consulted with me on th..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you had consulted with me on this beforehand, I would have warned you against it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I bet the Golcondists don't feel t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I bet the Golcondists don't feel that way."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Indeed, they welcomed the change...."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, they welcomed the change. But their jubilation has made the rest of the kingdom all the more furious."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I understand, Your Majesty, but yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand, Your Majesty, but you must have known that a backlash was inevitable."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our strict adherence to Wruhecism..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our strict adherence to Wruhecism was creating unnecessary division. Now the kingdom has been unified."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I am afraid Wruhecists do not see..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am afraid Wruhecists do not see it that way."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That's troubling news, Grand Wisem..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's troubling news, Grand Wiseman. Which groups are you referring to?"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Well... all of them, Your Grace.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well... all of them, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Dastnurists as well as mainstream..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dastnurists as well as mainstream Wruhecists. The Golcondists have stayed out of the fray thus far."

entries.dialogueText: "Golcondists and Dastnurists have stayed out of the fray thus far, but mainstream Wruhecists are joining the protests."

entries.dialogueText: "Golcondists and Dastnurists have joined the protests. Mainstream Wruhecists are staying out of the fray thus far."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Thankfully, only Dastnurists thus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thankfully, only Dastnurists thus far. Wruhecists have stayed out of the fray."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Thankfully, only Golcondists thus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thankfully, only Golcondists thus far, Though with their militant tendencies, they could contribute to the chaos significantly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's not good news. I've got to..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not good news. I've got to find a way to win back the support of the faithful."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""These congregants you're speaking..."
entries.dialogueText: "These congregants you're speaking of... can they be swayed from the reformists' side?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The leader of the reformists is a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The leader of the reformists is a godless Malenyevist. Do they really think he'll respect their religion more than I do?"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Yet with enough encouragement from..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet with enough encouragement from the Crown, they will return to the monarchy's side."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The whole country hungers for chan..."
entries.dialogueText: "The whole country hungers for change, it seems. Even those who've been mired in tradition for so long."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I believe they can. But only if th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe they can. But only if the Crown addresses their concerns."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""He claims he will give them a voic..."
entries.dialogueText: "He claims he will give them a voice. Something I very much doubt."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Agreed. If we foster peace among r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed. If we foster peace among religious groups, they could become a powerful advocate of the Crown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In times of unrest, it is good to..."
entries.dialogueText: "In times of unrest, it is good to know the faithful are on my side."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A mysterious expression passed acro..."
entries.dialogueText: A mysterious expression passed across Sal's face.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Yes. For now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. For now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What? How could they choose Manus..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? How could they choose Manus Sazon over me?"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Wruhecists, Dastnurists and Golcon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wruhecists, Dastnurists and Golcondists alike are voicing their dissatisfaction."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Mainstream Wruhecists in particula..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mainstream Wruhecists in particular."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Specifically, Golcondists and Dast..."
entries.dialogueText: "Specifically, Golcondists and Dastnurists."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Thankfully, the dissent is limited..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thankfully, the dissent is limited to Dastnurists thus far."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Thankfully, the dissent is limited..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thankfully, the dissent is limited to Golcondists thus far."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Specifically, Dastnurists and main..."
entries.dialogueText: "Specifically, Dastnurists and mainstream Wruhecists."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a man of faith myself, it warms..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a man of faith myself, it warms my heart to hear that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you're saying I have brought re..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you're saying I have brought religious harmony to Rizia? There's nothing left to do?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's troubling news.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's troubling news."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do they expect? I can't make..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do they expect? I can't make every religious group happy at the same time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I'm angering the faithful, I mu..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I'm angering the faithful, I must be doing something right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And how does this doubt impact the..."
entries.dialogueText: "And how does this doubt impact the kingdom?"

entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Unfortunately, through a loss of r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, through a loss of religious revenue, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I suggest you address these concer..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suggest you address these concerns, Your Majesty. We're facing a loss of religious revenue."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Thankfully, our religious revenues..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thankfully, our religious revenues are still in the black."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Through a loss of religious revenu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Through a loss of religious revenue, Your Majesty. Although thankfully, our numbers are still in the black."

entries.dialogueText: "I am a wise man, aren't I? You'd better watch out for your job."

entries.dialogueText: "The newly appointed local supervisors are showing great promise, and with their training underway, I’m confident they’ll be ready for the task ahead."

entries.dialogueText: “There’s also more manpower on-site now. While they might not be the most skilled, it's definitely making a dent in the workload.”

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty. Of, course."
